nodes.name: admin-integration-checklist.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive QA/integration checklist for the CleanCopy admin panel covering navigation, role-based permissions, page-level functionality, performance, accessibility, security, and deployment readiness across 80+ checkpoint sections.

nodes.name: useBrain.ts
nodes.summary: Custom React hook providing chat state management against the Brain assistant API, including message history, optimistic updates, error handling, and a companion hook for persisted chat histories.

nodes.name: useBrain
nodes.summary: Primary Brain chat hook that manages local message state, dispatches user input to the assistant endpoint, and reconciles streamed/error responses.

nodes.name: useChatHistory
nodes.summary: Loads and exposes paginated past Brain chat sessions for the current user.

nodes.name: useBrainSimple.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight variant of the Brain hook offering a minimal request/response surface for embedded UI widgets that need ad-hoc assistant queries without full chat state.

nodes.name: useBrainSimple
nodes.summary: Single-turn Brain query hook returning loading/error/data states for a single prompt.

nodes.name: viral_prediction.proto
nodes.summary: Protobuf schema defining the gRPC contract for the viral prediction service, including 39 messages covering prediction requests/responses, video metadata, content analysis features, batch processing, feature extraction, health check, and metrics endpoints.

nodes.name: ViralPredictionRequest
nodes.summary: Request message carrying video metadata and prediction options for a viral-prediction call.

nodes.name: ViralPredictionResponse
nodes.summary: Response message containing the prediction result, score breakdown, and content analysis.

nodes.name: BatchViralPredictionRequest
nodes.summary: Batch variant accepting multiple prediction requests in one call.

nodes.name: FeatureExtractionRequest
nodes.summary: Request to extract text/visual/audio features from a video without running a full prediction.

nodes.name: HealthCheckRequest
nodes.summary: Liveness/readiness probe request for the viral-prediction gRPC service.

nodes.name: MetricsRequest
nodes.summary: Request for service-level performance and throughput metrics.

nodes.name: viral-prediction-service.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript implementation of the viral prediction gRPC server that wires protobuf RPCs (predictViral, predictTikTokOptimized, batch, feature extraction, health, metrics) to the master viral algorithm and TikTok-specific analyzer services.

nodes.name: ViralPredictionGrpcService
nodes.summary: gRPC service class exposing twelve methods that route incoming requests to the master viral algorithm and TikTok analyzer, including lifecycle (start/stop), performance logging, and tier classification.

nodes.name: useModeManager.ts
nodes.summary: React hooks controlling the unified-interface mode state machine, including primary mode switching, per-component mode overrides, and transition orchestration.

nodes.name: useModeManager
nodes.summary: Top-level hook managing the application's active mode, persisting selection and broadcasting changes to subscribed components.

nodes.name: useComponentMode
nodes.summary: Per-component mode hook letting an individual component override or read the global mode context.

nodes.name: useModeTransitions
nodes.summary: Hook coordinating mode transition animations and lifecycle callbacks (entering/exiting).

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting all admin-domain React hooks (users, agencies, creators, campaigns, mini-apps, payouts, notifications, audit log, dashboards, operations) along with their filter types for consumer convenience.

nodes.name: useAdminUser.ts
nodes.summary: Hooks resolving the current admin user's profile, role, and effective permissions from Supabase, with a mock variant and a dev fallback wrapper for local development.

nodes.name: useAdminUser
nodes.summary: Primary hook that loads the authenticated user's admin profile and permission set from Supabase, exposing loading and error states.

nodes.name: useMockAdminUser
nodes.summary: Returns a synthetic admin user for local development and storybook scenarios.

nodes.name: useAgencies.ts
nodes.summary: Suite of agency-domain hooks (list, single, with stats, mutations) backed by Supabase queries with filter support and optimistic update helpers.

nodes.name: useAgencies
nodes.summary: Lists agencies with optional filters and pagination from Supabase.

nodes.name: useAgency
nodes.summary: Fetches a single agency by id with error/loading state.

nodes.name: useAgenciesWithStats
nodes.summary: Returns agencies joined with aggregated stats (creator count, payout totals, campaign performance).

nodes.name: useAgencyMutations
nodes.summary: Exposes create/update/delete mutations for agency records with optimistic UI updates.

nodes.name: useAgencyMutations.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone agency-mutation hook exposing typed insert/update/delete operations against the Supabase agencies table.

nodes.name: useAgencyMutations
nodes.summary: Provides typed create/update/delete handlers for agencies with error normalization.

nodes.name: useAuditLog.ts
nodes.summary: Audit-log query hooks for filtering, by-resource, by-user, action enumeration, resource enumeration, and CSV export, all backed by Supabase.

nodes.name: useAuditLog
nodes.summary: Primary audit log fetch hook supporting compound filters, pagination, and reactive refetch.

nodes.name: useAuditLogActions
nodes.summary: Returns the distinct set of audit-log action names for use in filter dropdowns.

nodes.name: useAuditLogResourceTypes
nodes.summary: Returns the distinct resource-type values present in audit log entries.

nodes.name: useAuditLogExport
nodes.summary: Exports filtered audit-log entries to CSV with progress tracking and download trigger.

nodes.name: useAuth.ts
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper hook exposing the Supabase auth context to consumer components.

nodes.name: useAuth
nodes.summary: Reads the auth context, throwing if no provider is present.

nodes.name: useCampaigns.ts
nodes.summary: Campaign-domain hook suite covering base list, platform/content/app/active variants, single and stats queries, and mutation helpers against Supabase.

nodes.name: useCampaignsBase
nodes.summary: Underlying hook implementing filter/sort/pagination for campaigns; the typed wrappers (platform/content/app/active) call into it.

nodes.name: useCampaign
nodes.summary: Fetches a single campaign with its relations.

nodes.name: useCampaignWithStats
nodes.summary: Fetches a campaign together with engagement/payout aggregates.

nodes.name: useCampaignMutations
nodes.summary: Exposes create/update/archive/launch mutations for campaigns with optimistic UI handling.

nodes.name: useCreators.ts
nodes.summary: Creator-domain hook suite providing list, single, pending, by-agency, and mutation hooks backed by Supabase.

nodes.name: useCreators
nodes.summary: Lists creators with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

nodes.name: useCreator
nodes.summary: Fetches a single creator by id with profile and stats joined.

nodes.name: useAgencyCreators
nodes.summary: Returns creators belonging to a specified agency.

nodes.name: useCreatorMutations
nodes.summary: Create/update/approve/reject mutations for creator records.

nodes.name: useDashboardStats.ts
nodes.summary: Role-specific dashboard aggregation hooks (chairman, agency, developer, clipper) that compose multiple Supabase queries into a single stats payload per role.

nodes.name: useChairmanDashboardStats
nodes.summary: Platform-wide aggregate stats hook for the chairman role including totals across users, agencies, campaigns, payouts, and revenue.

nodes.name: useAgencyDashboardStats
nodes.summary: Aggregate stats hook scoped to an individual agency's creators, campaigns, and earnings.

nodes.name: useDeveloperDashboardStats
nodes.summary: Aggregate stats hook for the developer role focused on mini-app installs, revenue, and performance.

nodes.name: useClipperDashboardStats
nodes.summary: Aggregate stats hook for the clipper role covering clip submissions, approvals, and earnings.

nodes.name: useFeature.ts
nodes.summary: Thin feature-flag hook that evaluates a flag key via the flags evaluator and returns its boolean/value result for the current user context.

nodes.name: useImpersonation.ts
nodes.summary: Admin impersonation hook enabling chairman/sub-admin roles to assume the identity of another user, with start/stop, banner state, and Supabase session swapping.

nodes.name: useImpersonation
nodes.summary: Provides start/stop impersonation actions and current impersonation state, integrating with Supabase auth and audit log.

nodes.name: useMiniApps.ts
nodes.summary: Mini-app marketplace hooks (list, single, featured, pending, developer-owned, categories, mutations) backed by Supabase with filter/pagination support.

nodes.name: useMiniApps
nodes.summary: Lists mini-apps with filter, sort, and pagination.

nodes.name: useMiniApp
nodes.summary: Fetches a single mini-app by id with related developer info.

nodes.name: useFeaturedMiniApps
nodes.summary: Returns the curated list of featured mini-apps.

nodes.name: useDeveloperApps
nodes.summary: Returns mini-apps owned by a given developer id.

nodes.name: useMiniAppCategories
nodes.summary: Returns the available mini-app categories for filtering UI.

nodes.name: useMiniAppMutations
nodes.summary: Create/update/publish/feature mutations for mini-app records.

nodes.name: useNotifications.ts
nodes.summary: Notification hooks providing a filtered, paginated notification feed plus an unread-count badge query backed by Supabase realtime subscriptions.

nodes.name: useNotifications
nodes.summary: Main notifications hook providing filter, pagination, mark-as-read, and realtime updates.

nodes.name: useUnreadNotificationCount
nodes.summary: Returns and subscribes to the unread notification count for the current user.

nodes.name: useOperations.ts
nodes.summary: Operations / MLOps hook suite covering model metrics, training data, training jobs, system health, alerts, experiments, and a composed dashboard, all sourced from Supabase.

nodes.name: useModelMetrics

nodes.name: useTrainingData
nodes.summary: Lists training dataset rows with filter and pagination for the training-readiness UI.

nodes.name: useTrainingJobs
nodes.summary: Lists and monitors active/historical model-training jobs.

nodes.name: useSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Periodically polls and exposes platform component health (Python service, DB, scheduler, etc.).

nodes.name: useOperationsAlerts
nodes.summary: Streams operational alerts and lets the operator acknowledge them.

nodes.name: useExperiments
nodes.summary: Lists A/B experiments and exposes start/stop/promote actions.

nodes.name: useOperationsDashboard
nodes.summary: Composite hook that bundles model metrics, training, health, alerts and experiments for the main Operations dashboard view.

nodes.name: useOptimizedTemplateEngine.ts
nodes.summary: Hook exposing the optimized template engine with caching, preloaded common templates, and rendering helpers used by the content generation pipeline.

nodes.name: useOptimizedTemplateEngine
nodes.summary: Main hook providing memoized template lookup, render dispatch, and cache invalidation.

nodes.name: preloadCommonTemplates
nodes.summary: Eagerly loads and warms the cache with the most common templates at startup.

nodes.name: usePayouts.ts
nodes.summary: Payout-domain hooks (list, single, pending, stats, mutations) backed by Supabase covering filter/pagination, status updates, and aggregated metrics.

nodes.name: usePayouts

nodes.name: usePayout
nodes.summary: Fetches a single payout record with related entities.

nodes.name: usePayoutStats
nodes.summary: Aggregates payout totals, pending volume, average amount, etc.

nodes.name: usePayoutMutations
nodes.summary: Approve/reject/process/bulk mutations for payout records with optimistic updates.

nodes.name: usePermission.ts

nodes.name: useStrategy.ts

nodes.name: useStrategy
nodes.summary: Loads the current user's content strategy, exposes refresh, and handles loading/error states.

nodes.name: useVideoCreation
